title: Business loan purpose
content: The synthetic business loan funds working capital, inventory purchases and equipment purchases. Personal holiday expenses are outside the demo product scope.

title: Loan amount limits
content: The synthetic loan amount ranges from INR 100000 to INR 2000000. Requested amounts outside these limits require a human review and cannot be automatically qualified.

title: Repayment term
content: The synthetic repayment term ranges from 12 to 36 months. The final repayment schedule requires a written offer from a human representative.
